sentences.text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA  CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2026  (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No.21146/2025)
 RAJEEV   VERSUS  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH & ORS. 
 O R D E R 1.
Leave granted.
2. We have heard learned senior counsel/counsel for the parties.
3. It seems to us that there are no sufficient and valid grounds on which the High Court could recall the order granting anticipatory bail to the appellant.
4. Consequently, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order dated 17.12.2025 is set aside.
5. It is directed that the appellant shall remain on bail subject to the same terms and conditions as already imposed during the pendency of the trial.
6. It is, however, clarified that the granting of anticipatory bail shall not be an impediment for the competent Authority to take other preventive measures 16:57:14 IST

Reason:
against the industrial unit, if it is found that the product contains any poisonous or unhealthy substance under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

(SURYA KANT) ....................J. (JOYMALYA BAGCHI) ....................J. (N.V.
